raw_text: Border Security Force personnel shot down a Pakistani hexacopter drone near Amritsar on the Punjab international border early Tuesday morning. The drone was carrying a payload of approximately five kilograms of heroin with an estimated street value of Rs 25 crore. This is the third drone incursion along the Punjab border in the past week, highlighting the persistent narco-terror threat from across the border. Intelligence agencies suspect a narco-terror nexus operating from Pakistan's Kasur district. Anti-drone systems have been deployed at forward posts along the vulnerable stretch.
clean_text: BSF shot down Pakistani drone near Amritsar carrying 5kg heroin worth Rs 25 crore. Third incursion this week. Narco-terror nexus from Pakistan's Kasur district suspected.
